```{r}
# # Target population parameters
# RR <- 2 # This is the estimand. Combined with baseline risk, determines risk in the exposed
# baserisk <- 0.01 # Baseline risk in the unexposed
# prevE <- 0.2 # Exposure prevalence in the target population
# niter <- 100000 # simulating 1,000,000 iterations
# ssize <- 40000 # sample size = 40,000 (100x # cases, 390 cases, ~ 400)
# prD1E1 <- 0.75
# prD1E0 <- 0.95
# prD0E1 <- 0.82
# prD0E0 <- 0.88
# nsubiter <- 1000
```
## Writing a function (SIM_FUN) for the simulation
```{r}
SIM_FUN <- function(niter, ssize, RR, prevE, baserisk, prD1E1, prD1E0, prD0E1, prD0E0, nsubiter) {
  
  #### COHORT SIMULATION DATA GENERATION
  E1 <- rbinom(niter, ssize, prevE) # total exposed
  E0 <- ssize - E1 # total unexposed
  D1E1 <- rbinom(niter, E1, RR*baserisk) # exposed cases
  D1E0 <- rbinom(niter, E0, baserisk) # unexposed cases
  
  #### CALCULATING TRUE RR ESTIMATE FOR COHORT
  RR1 <- (D1E1/E1)/(D1E0/E0)
  
  #### DATA GENERATION FOR CASE-COHORT ESTIMATE
  D0 <- (D1E1 + D1E0)*2 # 2 controls per case
  D0E1 <- rbinom(niter, D0, prevE) # exposed controls
  D0E0 <- D0 - D0E1 # unexposed controls
  
  #### CALCULATING OR ESTIMATE FOR CASE-COHORT
  OR <- (D1E1/D0E1)/(D1E0/D0E0)
  L_SERR <- sqrt(1/D1E1+1/D0E1+1/D1E0+1/D0E0)
  ME_OR <- qnorm(0.975)*L_SERR
  LCL95 <- OR*exp(-ME_OR)
  UCL95 <- OR*exp(ME_OR)
  MSE <- mean((log(OR) - log(RR))^2)
  coverage <- ifelse(LCL95 <= RR & UCL95 >= RR, 1, 0)
  
  #### EXPOSURE PREVALENCE CASES AND CONTROLS
  prevE_D1 <- D1E1/(D1E1+D1E0)
  prevE_D0 <- D0E1/(D0E1+D0E0)

  #### DATA GENERATION FOR BIASED ESTIMATE
  pD1E1 <- rbinom(niter, D1E1, prD1E1)
  pD1E0 <- rbinom(niter, D1E0, prD1E0)
  pD0E1 <- rbinom(niter, D0E1, prD0E1)
  pD0E0 <- rbinom(niter, D0E0, prD0E0)
  
  #### CALCULATING BIASED OR ESTIMATE
  OR_b <- (pD1E1/pD0E1)/(pD1E0/pD0E0) 
  median(OR_b)
  L_SERR_b <- sqrt(1/pD1E1+1/pD0E1+1/pD1E0+1/pD0E0)
  ME_OR_b <- qnorm(0.975)*L_SERR_b
  LCL95_b <- OR_b*exp(-ME_OR_b)
  UCL95_b <- OR_b*exp(ME_OR_b)
  MSE_b <- mean((log(OR_b) - log(RR))^2)
  coverage_b <- ifelse(LCL95_b <= RR & UCL95_b >= RR, 1, 0)
  
  #### DATA GENERATION FOR BETA ADJUSTMENT
  ## TOTAL NON-PARTICIPATING CASES & CONTROLS BY EXPOSURE STATUS
  npD1E1 <- D1E1-pD1E1
  npD1E0 <- D1E0-pD1E0
  npD0E1 <- D0E1-pD0E1
  npD0E0 <- D0E0-pD0E0
  
  ## TOTAL NON-PARTICIPATING CASES & CONTROLS
  npD1 <- npD1E1 + npD1E0
  npD0 <- npD0E1 + npD0E0
  
  ## EXPOSURE PREVALENCE NON-PARTICIPATING CASES & CONTROLS
  prevE_np_D1 <- npD1E1/npD1
  prevE_np_D0 <- npD0E1/npD0
  
  ## EXPOSURE PREVALENCE PARTICIPATING CASES & CONTROLS
  prevE_p_D1 <- pD1E1/(pD1E1 + pD1E0)
  prevE_p_D0 <- pD0E1/(pD0E1 + pD0E0)
  
  ## SET UP PARALLEL PROCESSING
  plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

  #### FIRST ADJUSTED ESTIMATE
  CL95_list_a1 <- future_lapply(1:niter, function(i) {
  
    #### EXPOSURE PREVALENCE - NON-PARTICIPATING CASES - CENTERED ON NPD1E1/NPD0E0 & NPD0E1/NPD0E0
    prevE_np_D1_b1 <- rbeta(nsubiter, npD1E1[i]+1, npD1E0[i]+1)
    prevE_np_D0_b1 <- rbeta(nsubiter, npD0E1[i]+1, npD0E0[i]+1)

    npD1E1_a1 <- rbinom(nsubiter, npD1[i], prevE_np_D1_b1) # NONPARTICIPATING EXPOSED CASES
    npD1E0_a1 <- npD1[i] - npD1E1_a1 # NONPARTICIPATING UNEXPOSED CASES
    npD0E1_a1 <- rbinom(nsubiter, npD0[i], prevE_np_D0_b1) # NONPARTICIPATING EXPOSED CONTROLS
    npD0E0_a1 <- npD0[i] - npD0E1_a1 # NONPARTICIPATING UNEXPOSED CONTROLS
    
    #### CALCULATING BIAS-ADJUSTED OR FOR RANDOM TRAPEZOIDAL
    OR_a1_vec <- ((pD1E1[i] + npD1E1_a1) / (pD1E0[i] + npD1E0_a1)) / 
                ((pD0E1[i] + npD0E1_a1) / (pD0E0[i] + npD0E0_a1))
    L_SERR_a1 <- sqrt((1/(pD1E1[i]))+(1/(pD1E0[i])) + 
                             (1/(pD0E1[i])) + (1/(pD0E0[i])))
    OR_a1_vec <- exp(log(OR_a1_vec) + rnorm(nsubiter) * L_SERR_a1)
    
    ### CALCULATE 95% SI
    quantiles1 <- quantile(OR_a1_vec, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
    c(quantiles1, ifelse(quantiles1[1] <= RR & quantiles1[3] >= RR, 1, 0))
    
  }, future.seed = TRUE)

  CL95_a1 <- do.call(rbind, CL95_list_a1)
  
  #### SECOND ADJUSTED ESTIMATE
  CL95_list_a2 <- future_lapply(1:niter, function(i) {
  
    #### EXPOSURE PREVALENCE - NON-PARTICIPATING CASES - CENTERED ON PD1E1/PD0E0 & PD0E1/PD0E0
    prevE_np_D1_b2 <- rbeta(nsubiter, pD1E1[i]+1, pD1E0[i]+1)
    prevE_np_D0_b2 <- rbeta(nsubiter, pD0E1[i]+1, pD0E0[i]+1)

    npD1E1_a2 <- rbinom(nsubiter, npD1[i], prevE_np_D1_b2) # NONPARTICIPATING EXPOSED CASES
    npD1E0_a2 <- npD1[i] - npD1E1_a2 # NONPARTICIPATING UNEXPOSED CASES
    npD0E1_a2 <- rbinom(nsubiter, npD0[i], prevE_np_D0_b2) # NONPARTICIPATING EXPOSED CONTROLS
    npD0E0_a2 <- npD0[i] - npD0E1_a2 # NONPARTICIPATING UNEXPOSED CONTROLS
    
    #### CALCULATING BIAS-ADJUSTED OR FOR RANDOM TRAPEZOIDAL
    OR_a2_vec <- ((pD1E1[i] + npD1E1_a2) / (pD1E0[i] + npD1E0_a2)) / 
                ((pD0E1[i] + npD0E1_a2) / (pD0E0[i] + npD0E0_a2))
    L_SERR_a2 <- sqrt((1/(pD1E1[i]))+(1/(pD1E0[i])) + 
                             (1/(pD0E1[i])) + (1/(pD0E0[i])))
    OR_a2_vec <- exp(log(OR_a2_vec) + rnorm(nsubiter) * L_SERR_a2)
    
    ### CALCULATE 95% SI
    quantiles2 <- quantile(OR_a2_vec, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
    c(quantiles2, ifelse(quantiles2[1] <= RR & quantiles2[3] >= RR, 1, 0))
    
  }, future.seed = TRUE)

  CL95_a2 <- do.call(rbind, CL95_list_a2)
  
  ## SAVING RESULTS
  res <- data.frame(RR1, OR, LCL95, UCL95, MSE, coverage, OR_b, LCL95_b, UCL95_b, MSE_b, coverage_b, prevE_D1, prevE_D0, prevE_p_D1, prevE_p_D0, prevE_np_D1, prevE_np_D0)
  res_a1 <- as.data.frame(CL95_a1)
  colnames(res_a1) <- c("LCL95_a", "median_OR_a", "UCL95_a","coverage_a")
  res_a2 <- as.data.frame(CL95_a2)
  colnames(res_a2) <- c("LCL95_a", "median_OR_a", "UCL95_a", "coverage_a")

  return(list(res = res, res_a1 = res_a1, res_a2 = res_a2))
}
```
## Simulation 1
Cases: Marginal = 85%
- D1E1 = 75%
- D1E0 = 95%

Controls: Marginal = 85%
- D0E1 = 82%
- D0E0 = 88%
```{r}
true_RR = 2
set.seed(seed = 23) 
sim1 <- SIM_FUN(niter = 100000, ssize = 40000, RR = 2, prevE = 0.2, baserisk = 0.01, prD1E1 = 0.75, prD1E0 = 0.95, prD0E1 = 0.82, prD0E0 = 0.88, nsubiter = 10000)

sim1_res <- sim1$res
sim1_res_a1 <- sim1$res_a1
sim1_res_a2 <- sim1$res_a2

## summary of exposure prevalences
# case-cohort
summary(sim1_res$prevE_D1)
summary(sim1_res$prevE_D0)
# participants only
summary(sim1_res$prevE_p_D1)
summary(sim1_res$prevE_p_D0)
# non-participants
summary(sim1_res$prevE_np_D1)
summary(sim1_res$prevE_np_D0)

## true OR
summary(sim1_res$OR)
sim1_median_OR <- median(sim1_res$OR)
quantile(sim1_res$OR, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
median(sim1_res$MSE)
sim1_MSE <- median(sim1_res$MSE)
sum(sim1_res$coverage)/length(sim1_res$coverage)
sim1_coverage <- sum(sim1_res$coverage)/length(sim1_res$coverage)

## biased OR
summary(sim1_res$OR_b)
sim1_median_OR_b <- median(sim1_res$OR_b)
quantile(sim1_res$OR_b, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
median(sim1_res$MSE_b)
sim1_MSE_b <- median(sim1_res$MSE_b)
sum(sim1_res$coverage_b)/length(sim1_res$coverage_b)
sim1_coverage_b <- sum(sim1_res$coverage_b)/length(sim1_res$coverage_b)

## beta (centered on npD1E1/npD1E0 & npD0E1/npD0E0)
summary(sim1_res_a1$median_OR_a)
sim1_median_OR_a1 <- median(sim1_res_a1$median_OR_a)
quantile(sim1_res_a1$median_OR_a, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
sim1_MSE_a1 <- (mean((log(sim1_res_a1$median_OR_a) - log(true_RR))^2))
sim1_MSE_a1
sum(sim1_res_a1$coverage_a)/length(sim1_res_a1$coverage_a)
sim1_coverage_a1 <- sum(sim1_res_a1$coverage_a)/length(sim1_res_a1$coverage_a)

## beta (centered on pD1E1/pD1E0 & pD0E1/pD0E0)
summary(sim1_res_a2$median_OR_a)
sim1_median_OR_a2 <- median(sim1_res_a2$median_OR_a)
quantile(sim1_res_a2$median_OR_a, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
sim1_MSE_a2 <- (mean((log(sim1_res_a2$median_OR_a) - log(true_RR))^2))
sim1_MSE_a2
sum(sim1_res_a2$coverage_a)/length(sim1_res_a2$coverage_a)
sim1_coverage_a2 <-sum(sim1_res_a2$coverage_a)/length(sim1_res_a2$coverage_a)
```
## Simulation 2
Cases: Marginal = 85%
- D1E1 = 82%
- D1E0 = 88%
Controls: Marginal = 85%
- D0E1 = 75%
- D0E0 = 95%
```{r}
set.seed(seed = 23)
sim2 <- SIM_FUN(niter = 100000, ssize = 40000, RR = 2, prevE = 0.2, baserisk = 0.01 , prD1E1 = 0.82, prD1E0 = 0.88, prD0E1 = 0.75, prD0E0 = 0.95, nsubiter = 10000)

sim2_res <- sim2$res
sim2_res_a1 <- sim2$res_a1
sim2_res_a2 <- sim2$res_a2
sim2_res_a3 <- sim2$res_a3

## summary of exposure prevalences
# case-cohort
summary(sim2_res$prevE_D1)
summary(sim2_res$prevE_D0)
# participants only
summary(sim2_res$prevE_p_D1)
summary(sim2_res$prevE_p_D0)
# non-participants
summary(sim2_res$prevE_np_D1)
summary(sim2_res$prevE_np_D0)

## true OR
summary(sim2_res$OR)
sim2_median_OR <- median(sim2_res$OR)
quantile(sim2_res$OR, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
median(sim2_res$MSE)
sim2_MSE <- median(sim2_res$MSE)
sum(sim2_res$coverage)/length(sim2_res$coverage)
sim2_coverage <- sum(sim2_res$coverage)/length(sim2_res$coverage)

## biased OR
summary(sim2_res$OR_b)
sim2_median_OR_b <- median(sim2_res$OR_b)
quantile(sim2_res$OR_b, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
median(sim2_res$MSE_b)
sim2_MSE_b <- median(sim2_res$MSE_b)
sum(sim2_res$coverage_b)/length(sim2_res$coverage_b)
sim2_coverage_b <- sum(sim2_res$coverage_b)/length(sim2_res$coverage_b)

## beta (centered on npD1E1/npD1E0 & npD0E1/npD0E0)
summary(sim2_res_a1$median_OR_a)
sim2_median_OR_a1 <- median(sim2_res_a1$median_OR_a)
quantile(sim2_res_a1$median_OR_a, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
sim2_MSE_a1 <- mean((log(sim2_res_a1$median_OR_a) - log(true_RR))^2)
sim2_MSE_a1
sum(sim2_res_a1$coverage_a)/length(sim2_res_a1$coverage_a)
sim2_coverage_a1 <- sum(sim2_res_a1$coverage_a)/length(sim2_res_a1$coverage_a)

## beta (centered on pD1E1/pD1E0 & pD0E1/pD0E0)
summary(sim2_res_a2$median_OR_a)
sim2_median_OR_a2 <- median(sim2_res_a2$median_OR_a)
quantile(sim2_res_a2$median_OR_a, probs=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
sim2_MSE_a2 <- mean((log(sim2_res_a2$median_OR_a) - log(true_RR))^2)
sim2_MSE_a2
sum(sim2_res_a2$coverage_a)/length(sim2_res_a2$coverage_a)
sim2_coverage_a2 <-sum(sim2_res_a2$coverage_a)/length(sim2_res_a2$coverage_a)
```
